text: 晶华微：公司及控股股东吕汉泉于2026年11月2日收到中国证监会《立案告知书》，因涉嫌信息披露违法违规等被中国证监会立案
text_en: Jinghua Micro: The company and controlling shareholder Lu Hanquan received the China Securities Regulatory Commission's "Notice of Case Filing" on November 2, 2026, and were placed under CSRC investigation on suspicion of information disclosure violations and other issues
